subject: Launch escape-hatch & risk ladder for upcoming QBR readout
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, j.sanders@acme.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Launch escape-hatch & risk ladder for upcoming QBR readout

Team —

Ahead of the QBR readout next week I pulled together a short "risk ladder" and an escape-hatch playbook that capture the remaining open risks for the R1 product launch and the concrete mitigations. High level: we still have three delivery risks that could materially change the Exec ask if they land (infra perf under 95th percentile SLA, integration bug with BetaCloud, and a localized data migration issue for a small cohort of customers).

What I'm asking for from this thread:
- Confirm 2-tier escape-hatch actions (soft-delay vs. targeted rollback) for the presentation deck by EOD Monday.
- Ops to validate whether we can support a rolling rollback with no customer-visible downtime (Evelyn, can you confirm by EOD tomorrow?).
- Product to agree on the minimal set of features we MUST ship to meet the QBR success criteria (Laura, propose a trimmed scope).

Attachments: risk_ladder_v2.xlsx (master list + severity scoring), launch-escape-hatch-ops-playbook.pdf (playbook with runbooks), timeline-snapshots-APR02.png (current ETA map).

Quick summary of the ladder (details in the sheet):
1) Infra perf: risk score HIGH — mitigation: enable conservative batching window + scale reserve (pre-allocated). Estimated delta: +2ms p50, cost +12%.
2) BetaCloud integration: risk score MEDIUM-HIGH — mitigation: cut to integration v1 fallback route and QA smoke for edge flows. Requires partner switch acceptance.
3) Migration cohort: risk score MEDIUM — mitigation: staggered migration + preflight checks; will impact only <3% of customers.

I want the run-of-show language to include an "escape-hatch ladder" slide that makes the tradeoffs explicit. We'll propose the default is to proceed; if infra perf breaches the SLA for >15 minutes during the preflight window we pause and enact the soft-delay (delay non-critical rollout steps for 48 hours to apply hotfix + extended monitoring). If BetaCloud reports critical fail we escalate to partner rollback and flip routing.

Please reply with short bullets. I'll synthesize into the QBR narrative.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Product & Roadmap
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, j.sanders@acme.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch escape-hatch & risk ladder for upcoming QBR readout

Markus —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick bullets from Product after reviewing the ladder and the trimmed scope proposal:
- Minimal ship set (for QBR success): streaming stability, core prompts + embeddings, and expanded API throttling controls. Everything else (analytics UI, extended eval dashboards) moves to Post-Launch(30).
- We can adopt the soft-delay decision as written. Product proposes a "graceful feature freeze" window that prevents merge of non-critical PRs during the preflight window to minimize last-minute regressions.
- For BetaCloud integration: recommend we plan a partner-firewall route where BetaCloud traffic is mirrored and validated for 24h before flip. That reduces rollback pain and keeps routing simple.

Open ask: need one owner for the partner-firewall validation (Laura -> suggest Evelyn Ops lead + BetaCloud contacts).

Will work with @Engineering to update the customer communication templates for the 48h soft-delay option.

Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, j.sanders@acme.com, ops@betacloud.io
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch escape-hatch & risk ladder for upcoming QBR readout

Markus / Laura —

Ops read: the escape-hatch playbook is in the right shape; a few clarifications:
- Rolling rollback with zero customer-visible downtime is unlikely for the full fleet unless we limit to a canary + staged rollback. We can promise near-zero impact for the 90% baseline but reserve small cohort maintenance windows for the migrated customers.
- We can enable the conservative batching window and reserve a small pool of nodes for preflight; will require a short runbook change and a one-time allocation (cost delta as noted).
- For BetaCloud, Ops can own the partner-firewall run starting Monday 04/05. I'll nominate Priya Natarajan as lead and coordinate the shared smoke tests.

I'll attach two short runbooks (referenced in the playbook) to make the QBR appendix cleaner.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Site Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: runbook-rolling-rollback.md (referenced), preflight-node-allocation.md

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: j.sanders@acme.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch escape-hatch & risk ladder for upcoming QBR readout

Thanks for the quick synthesis. A few executive alignment notes:
- I want the QBR deck to present the default plan (proceed) and clearly enumerate the three gating signals that would flip us to the soft-delay. Put those gating signals on the slide with short contingency costs (time and $).
- Approve Evelyn's staffing suggestion (Priya lead) and Laura's minimal ship set.
- For the customer-facing comms: keep them short and reassuring; legal has pre-approved a template for a 48h delay. Laura, work with Legal to finalize copy by Monday noon.

One ask for Product/Engineering: capture the expected impact on OKRs if we execute the soft-delay vs. proceed (2-3 bullet delta on key metrics: on-time delivery %, feature velocity, and NPS impact). I need that for the Exec narrative.

Vivek
COO
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch escape-hatch & risk ladder for upcoming QBR readout

Thanks everyone — summary for the deck and next steps (I'll own synthesis):
- Decision: proceed by default. Soft-delay (48h) is the official escape-hatch if infra perf breach > 15m or BetaCloud critical integration failure.
- Owners: Evelyn -> Ops lead (Priya) to run partner-firewall validation; Laura -> finalize minimal ship set + customer comms; Engineering (cc'd via product channel) -> quantify OKR deltas for soft-delay by EOD Monday.
- Deliverables for QBR packet (due Tue 04/06): updated deck slide with ladder, appendix runbooks (Ops), customer comms draft (Legal signoff), and a 1-slide OKR impact summary.

I'll incorporate the attachments and circulate the final deck on Monday morning for a final review.

Markus
VP, Product & Roadmap
